<p>For anyone looking to get a great deal on a streaming device, Roku's Black Friday deals are here. The <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:Amazon;elmt:;cpos:1;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=66ea567a-c987-4c2e-a2ff-02904efde6ea&amp;itemId=amazon_B0DXY833HV&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=062bb414-88ff-4f53-8a56-9c8970bbb5e9&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=Amazon&amp;linkText=Roku+Streaming+Stick+Plus&amp;&amp;signature=AQAAAVqTm22NL7krBeApej8l-a4IoSwV3L8tLSQxdxmuYSPw&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FRoku-Streaming-Stick-Plus-2025%2Fdp%2FB0DXY833HV%2F" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://www.amazon.com/Roku-Streaming-Stick-Plus-2025/dp/B0DXY833HV/?th=1">Roku Streaming Stick Plus</a>, which just happens to be one of our <a data-i13n="cpos:2;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/entertainment/streaming/best-streaming-devices-media-players-123021395.html">favorite streaming devices</a>, is 50 percent off, on <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:Amazon;elmt:;cpos:3;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=66ea567a-c987-4c2e-a2ff-02904efde6ea&amp;itemId=amazon_B0DXY833HV&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=062bb414-88ff-4f53-8a56-9c8970bbb5e9&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=Amazon&amp;linkText=sale+for+just+%2419&amp;&amp;signature=AQAAAVqTm22NL7krBeApej8l-a4IoSwV3L8tLSQxdxmuYSPw&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FRoku-Streaming-Stick-Plus-2025%2Fdp%2FB0DXY833HV%2F" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://www.amazon.com/Roku-Streaming-Stick-Plus-2025/dp/B0DXY833HV/?th=1">sale for just $19</a>. The regular <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:Amazon;elmt:;cpos:4;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=66ea567a-c987-4c2e-a2ff-02904efde6ea&amp;itemId=amazon_B0DXXYS4BJ&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=062bb414-88ff-4f53-8a56-9c8970bbb5e9&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=Amazon&amp;linkText=Streaming+Stick&amp;&amp;signature=AQAAAcTtIFr-OedS6tQLI5KMOjdmrGmQZhRiRs0xKkYV4h3l&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FRoku-Streaming-Stick-HD-2025%2Fdp%2FB0DXXYS4BJ%2Fref%3Dast_sto_dp_puis" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://www.amazon.com/Roku-Streaming-Stick-HD-2025/dp/B0DXXYS4BJ/ref=ast_sto_dp_puis">Streaming Stick</a> and <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:Amazon;elmt:;cpos:5;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=66ea567a-c987-4c2e-a2ff-02904efde6ea&amp;itemId=amazon_B09BKCDXZC&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=062bb414-88ff-4f53-8a56-9c8970bbb5e9&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=Amazon&amp;linkText=Streaming+Stick+4K&amp;&amp;signature=AQAAARAG80-6AC1-rXJrvn-WMttD6knCsdJnLoShxMwH6Wkc&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FRoku-Streaming-Device-Vision-Controls%2Fdp%2FB09BKCDXZC%2Fref%3Dast_sto_dp_puis" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://www.amazon.com/Roku-Streaming-Device-Vision-Controls/dp/B09BKCDXZC/ref=ast_sto_dp_puis">Streaming Stick 4K</a> are also on sale for 50 percent off, coming in at $15 and $25 respectively.</p> 
<p>
 </p> 
<p>Roku makes some of the best streaming devices you can get, and any of the ones on sale would be great picks to upgrade an old TV you already have. The Streaming Stick Plus is our favorite of the bunch since it supports 4K HDR content and gives you access to a bunch of free content thanks to Roku's streaming OS. We also appreciate its accurate universal search and the fact that it draws power from your TV, so it doesn't need to be plugged into a wall outlet to get power.</p> <span id="end-legacy-contents"></span>
<p>The standard Streaming Stick is a good alternative to Amazon's most basic Fire TV Stick, and if you already prefer Roku's streaming OS, it's arguably the better choice. The Streaming Stick 4K adds Dolby Vision into the mix, if that's a must-have for you. Also, if you're looking for a more powerful set-top streaming box, the <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:Amazon;elmt:;cpos:6;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=66ea567a-c987-4c2e-a2ff-02904efde6ea&amp;itemId=amazon_B0DF44RTTP&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=062bb414-88ff-4f53-8a56-9c8970bbb5e9&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=Amazon&amp;linkText=Roku+Ultra&amp;&amp;signature=AQAAAddMcqHARB1ldF7vuajZp-Xuvj5CjM_qbsBL647SRgwR&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FRoku-Ultra-2024-Streaming-Rechargeable%2Fdp%2FB0DF44RTTP%2Fref%3Dast_sto_dp_puis" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://www.amazon.com/Roku-Ultra-2024-Streaming-Rechargeable/dp/B0DF44RTTP/ref=ast_sto_dp_puis">Roku Ultra</a> is 30 percent off, marked down to $69 from $100.</p>
